description: This source file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a method to split a string into tokens based on spaces and stores the tokens in a custom LinkedList. It includes private helper functions for token validation and addition.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a source string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (not empty).
